description: This file defines the Division class, which extends the Multiplication class to implement division operations for matrices or scalar values within the Matrix library. It includes an execute method that handles various input types and performs division accordingly.

classes.name: Division
classes.description: A class representing the division operation in the matrix manipulation library, supporting division of matrices and scalars.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the division of the current object by a given value, which can be a matrix or scalar, and supports method chaining.
